source_section: Restatement of Previously Issued Consolidated Financial Statements; FY2017 income-statement bridge
interpretation: The 716 million USD difference includes an 80 million USD restatement effect and a 636 million USD ASU 2017-07 presentation change. Do not call the entire difference an error correction.
missing_tag_interpretation: The named standard revenue tag is absent from the downloaded companyfacts taxonomy, while the actual filing reports net sales. This demonstrates API/tag coverage failure, not missing business revenue.
scope: Reference tests only. KHC is not a supported interactive issuer. Its NetIncomeLoss tag is net income attributable to the issuer (Kraft Heinz), which differs from consolidated net income (ProfitLoss) because KHC reports noncontrolling interests; exposing it would require a separate statement review.
